categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Huayan Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research, production, and sales of PET preform intelligent molding systems, preform molds, and related products. The company also provides mold refurbishment, maintenance, equipment upgrades, preform design, and production line planning services. Additionally, it produces and sells preform products through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced injection molding technology for PET preform production, including its proprietary Epioneer series high-end intelligent molding systems capable of supporting up to 192-cavity molds. The systems integrate hardware and software for real-time data interaction and precise intelligent control. The company emphasizes high-speed, multi-cavity mold technology, energy efficiency, and automation, supported by a strong R&D team with over 80 members and 179 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large-scale fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) companies in sectors such as bottled water, beverages, edible oils, and daily chemical products. Notable clients include Jinmailang, Dali Foods, Wahaha, Yili, Yibao, Jing Tian, COFCO Coca-Cola, and Genki Forest. The products serve domestic and international markets, supporting packaging needs in food, dairy, alcohol, and pharmaceutical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant sales in domestic regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest. It has a growing international presence with exports accounting for 31.55% of revenue, targeting Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, the Middle East, New Zealand, Turkey, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huayan Precision Machinery operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of specialized injection molding equipment and molds for PET preform production. It also engages in downstream activities by producing preform products and providing after-sales services such as maintenance and upgrades.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing production capacity and technological innovation through projects like the expansion of intelligent molding systems and high-speed multi-cavity molds. R&D priorities include multi-color injection molding systems, high-speed preform production, energy-efficient systems, bottle cap production, and automated visual inspection systems. It maintains a strong R&D investment (~4.7% of revenue) and aims to improve product intelligence, energy efficiency, and international competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of PET preform intelligent molding systems, molds, preform products, and related services including maintenance, refurbishment, and equipment upgrades. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with export sales contributing significantly to total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huayan Precision Machinery is one of the earliest and leading domestic companies in the PET preform injection molding equipment industry in China. It has narrowed the technology gap with international competitors and holds a strong market position with recognized product quality and innovation. The company faces competition from both domestic and international manufacturers but benefits from its advanced technology and established customer base.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 645.8 million, a 21.17% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders reaching RMB 101.26 million, up 33.29%. Total assets grew by 11% to RMB 1.606 billion. The company maintains steady growth driven by market expansion, product innovation, and increased overseas sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huayan Precision Machinery emphasizes high-speed, high-efficiency, and energy-saving intelligent molding systems with multi-cavity mold compatibility, offering customized solutions tailored to diverse customer needs. Its Epioneer series represents advanced domestic technology capable of meeting international standards. The company also provides comprehensive after-sales services and continuous innovation to enhance customer productivity and product quality.
